facts.fact: 婚礼请柬（象牙卡水彩粉丝带）摆在床头腐朽里；她想穿无血之裙——「not a stitch I possess that does not have sin woven in」
facts.anchor: no right to be surrounded by such decay

facts.fact: 白猫 mercurial：躺床蹭暖但不熟、哈气露牙——「I will give it time. It is all I have to give her.」
图书馆哭书幽灵今晚不叫了——「仿佛她明白我不会帮她」；「I offer up no words of comfort; there is none to give.」
facts.anchor: she understands I will not help her

facts.fact: 母亲咬她下巴（血滑下脖颈）、手里拎撕边请柬误认成 Rue 的婚约：「You will not wed. Not you.」——「你三天前还让我去」
Rue 内白：母亲的神智在裂（memory stretched near to snapping）——「Her sanity seems a high price to pay for immortality」若成疯狂之器、行走朽墓——会忘了我吗
「I am hungry. Famished, daughter.」——母亲转身像剥橙一样撕下 Veronica 臂上的肉条；Veronica 眼翻着笑、伸手讨喂：「Take what you wish from me.」
母亲吐渣嫌腻（too distasteful）、一巴掌扇晕 Veronica（头撞地）；血手印按上 Rue 肩头、合着听不见的华尔兹摇摆——「I am not so unlike Veronica, chomping at the fragments of my mother’s affection」
facts.anchor: chomping at the fragments of my mother’s affection

facts.fact: 「For Anne. You would go for Anne, your friend?」附条款放行：「Come back to me, dearest, before dawn.」；Rue 扶起 Veronica（伤口她从不让人帮、I have since stopped asking）；结尾幽灵眼里第一次浮现怜悯——「And that is a terrible thing indeed.」
facts.anchor: Do not leave me to bear it alone.
